第一釋名者，: 此經以能說、所說人為名。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: This sutra takes its title from the one who expounds it and from the one of whom he speaks.

第一釋名者，: 佛者， 此土能說之教主， 即釋迦牟尼如來，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Buddha is the master teacher, the one who expounds the scripture in this world, that is, Sakyamuni.

第一釋名者，: 乘大悲願力生五濁惡世，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: By the power of his vows of great compassion, he was born here in the world of the Five Turbidities.

第一釋名者，: 以先覺而覺後覺， 無法不知無法不見故名佛也。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: As the one who was first to awaken, his mission was to bring enlightenment to those who were to awaken later. Buddha is the one who knows all and sees all.

第一釋名者，: 說者， 悅所懷也， 佛以度生為懷，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Buddha speaks the sutra with joy in his heart. Buddha's intention is to liberate sentient beings.

第一釋名者，: 眾生機熟， 佛為應時說法令得度脫，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Since the potential of sentient beings to achieve enlightenment is ripe, Buddha expounds for them these Pure Land teachings which are difficult to believe, and enables his listeners to reach ultimate liberation.

第一釋名者，: 故悅也。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: That's why he is filled with joy.

第一釋名者，: 阿彌陀者， 即所說彼土之導師，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Amitabha Buddha is the one Sakyamuni refers to in the sutra. Amitabha is the guide of the Pure Land.

第一釋名者，: 以四十八願接信願念佛眾生， 令生極樂世界永階不退者也。 梵語阿彌陀，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: By the power of his forty-eight vows, he receives the sentient beings who have vowed to practice Buddha-remembrance by invoking the Buddha-name and enables them to be born in the Land of Ultimate Bliss, and never fall back from there.

第一釋名者，: 此云無量壽， 亦云無量光。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The Sanskrit name "Amitabha" means "Infinite Life" and also "Infinite Light".

第一釋名者，: 以要言之， 功德智慧， 神通道力， 依正莊嚴， 說法化度， 一一無量，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The essential point is that everything about him is infinite: his merits and his wisdom, his supernatural powers and his power in the Path, his embodiment and his environment, his work in expounding the Buddhist teachings and liberating sentient beings.

第一釋名者，: 聊舉壽命、光明二事以為言端耳。 經者、訓法訓常， 一切金口所宣通名為經，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: A sutra is any teaching from the golden mouth of a Buddha?

第一釋名者，: 今對佛說阿彌陀五字、即是通別合為題也。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: These terms taken together make up the title of the scripture: The Amitabha Sutra Spoken by Buddha.

第一釋名者，: 教。 行。 理三各論通別， 廣如台藏所明， 自應尋之，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The three categories -- teachings, practices, and inner truth (noumenon), which each sutra should have -- can each be explained in both general and particular senses, as set out in the T'ien-t'ai system.

第一釋名者，: 茲不繁述。 第二辨體者，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Second, there is the essence of the sutra to discern.

第一釋名者，: 諸大乘經皆以實相為正體。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The true essence of all the Great Vehicle (Mahayana) scriptures is Absolute Reality (Real Mark) itself.

第一釋名者，: 何謂實相？
First, there is the title of the sutra t: What is Absolute Reality?

第一釋名者，: 即現前一念心之自性是也。 吾人現前一念心性，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It is the Pure Mind of sentient beings.

第一釋名者，: 不在內、不在外、不在中間，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: This mind is not inside, not outside, and not in-between.

第一釋名者，: 非過去、非現在、非未來，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It is not past, not present, and not future.

第一釋名者，: 非青黃赤白、非長短方圓、非香、非味、非觸、非法，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It is not green or yellow or red or white, long or short or square or round. It is not a scent, not a flavor, not a texture, not a mental object.

第一釋名者，: 覓之了不可得而不可言其無，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: When we search for it we cannot find it, but we cannot say it does not exist.

第一釋名者，: 具造百界千如而不可言其有，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It creates all worlds and all realms, but we cannot say it exists.

第一釋名者，: 離一切緣慮分別相， 而緣慮分別亦非離此實相別有自性， 離一切語言文字相， 而語言文字亦非離此實相別有自性。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It is detached from conditioned thoughts and discriminations, from all words and characteristics, but conditioned thoughts and discriminations and worlds and characteristics do not have any separate identity apart from it. Essentially, absolute reality is detached from all characteristics, but merged with all phenomena.

第一釋名者，: 以要言之， 離一切相、即一切法， 唯其離一切相故無相，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Being detached from characteristics, it is formless, and being merged with all phenomena, it gives them all their forms.

第一釋名者，: 惟其即一切法故無不相， 無相無不相故不得已強名實相。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: For lack of an alternative, we impose on it the name "absolute reality" [i.e., Mind, Real Mark, Buddha Nature].

第一釋名者，: 實相之體非寂非照， 而復寂而恒照、照而恒寂，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The essence of Absolute Reality is neither quiescent nor aware, but it is both quiescent and yet ever shining with awareness, both shining with awareness and yet ever quiescent.

第一釋名者，: 照而恒寂強名為常寂光土，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: In that it is shining with awareness but quiescent, it is called the Land of Eternally Quiescent Light.

第一釋名者，: 寂而恒照強名清淨法身。 又照而恒寂強名法身，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: In that it is quiescent but shining with awareness, it is called the pure Dharmakaya (Dharma Body). Aware quiescence is called the Dharmakaya, the Dharma Body of all the Buddhas.

第一釋名者，: 寂而恒照強名報身。 又性德寂照強名法身， 修德寂照名報身。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Quiescent awareness is called the Sambhogakaya, the Reward Body.

第一釋名者，: 又修德照而恒寂名為受用身， 修德寂而恒照強名應化身。 當知寂照不二、性修不二、身土不二無非實相，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: [For the Buddhas] quiescence and awareness are not two, bodies and lands are not two, what is inherent and what is cultivated are not two, true essence and responsive function are not two -- everything is absolute reality.

第一釋名者，: 實相無二亦無不二，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Reality and appearances are neither two nor not two.

第一釋名者，: 是故舉體作依、作正、作法、作報、作自、作他，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Therefore, the essence of reality as a whole acts as both the environment that surrounds sentient beings and as their very bodies.

第一釋名者，: 乃至能說所說、能度所度、能信所信、能願所願、能持所持、能生所生、能讚所讚，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It acts as both the Dharma Body and the Reward Body of the Buddhas. It acts as both self and others. Thus the one who speaks the sutra and the one who is spoken of, the Buddhas that can deliver sentient beings and the sentient beings who are delivered, the ability to believe and that which is believed in, the ability to take vows and that which is vowed, the ability to concentrate on the Buddha-name and the Buddha-name which is concentrated upon, the ability to be born in the Pure Land and birth in the Pure Land itself, the ability to praise the Buddhas and the Buddhas who are praised -- all of these are the imprint of the "true seal" of Absolute Reality.

第一釋名者，: 無非實相正印之所印也。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: In other words, the True Mind (Bodhi Mind) of sentient beings is the essence of all Mahayana sutras.

第一釋名者，: 第三明宗者，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Third, there is the guiding principle to explain.

第一釋名者，: 宗是修行之要徑、會體之樞機， 而萬行之綱領也。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The guiding principle is the essential route for cultivating practice, the key link for understanding the essence [of our mind], the guiding framework for the myriad practices.

第一釋名者，: 提其綱則眾目皆張， 挈其領則襟袖隨至，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: When you hold up a net, the mesh opens up. When you lift the collar of a shirt, the breast and sleeves come too.

第一釋名者，: 故次體之後應須辨宗。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Thus, after explaining the essence of the sutra, we must discern the guiding principle.

第一釋名者，: 此經以信願持名為修行之宗要。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The essential principle for cultivation in this sutra is to develop faith and vows and to recite the Buddha-name.

第一釋名者，: 非信不足以啟願，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Without faith, we are not sufficiently equipped to take vows.

第一釋名者，: 非願不足以導行，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Without vows, we are not sufficiently equipped to guide our practice.

第一釋名者，: 非持名妙行不足以滿其所願而證所信，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Without the wondrous practice of reciting the Buddha-name, we are not sufficiently equipped to fulfill our vows and to bring our faith to fruition.

第一釋名者，: 是故經中先演極樂依正以生信，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: The sutra first sets forth the pure environment of the Land and the exalted bodies of its inhabitants in order to engender faith in us.

第一釋名者，: 次勸應當發願以導行，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Next it urges us to take vows to give guidance to our practice.

第一釋名者，: 次示七日持名以徑登不退。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Then it teaches the practice of reciting the Buddha-name as the route of direct ascent with no falling back (non-retrogression).

第一釋名者，: 信則信自、信他、信因、信果、信事、信理，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Faith means having faith in oneself and faith in others (Buddha and Bodhisattvas). It means being sure about cause and effect, about phenomena and inner truth (noumenon).

第一釋名者，: 願則厭離娑婆欣求極樂，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Vows mean feeling aversion to the mundane world and detaching from it. Vows mean gladly seeking the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss.

第一釋名者，: 行則執持名號一心不亂。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Practice means persisting in the practice of reciting the Buddha-name singlemindedly and without confusion (with one-pointedness of mind).

第一釋名者，: 信自者， 信我現前一念之心本非肉團亦非緣影， 竪無初後、橫絕邊涯，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: [Faith]. Believing in ourselves means believing that the True Mind is not a physical manifestation, and not the reflection of entangling objects, that it extends through time without any before or after and through space without any boundaries.

第一釋名者，: 終日隨緣、終日不變。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Though it follows causal conditions all day long, it never changes.

第一釋名者，: 十方虛空微塵國土， 元我一念心中所現之物，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: All of space in the Ten Directions and all the worlds countless as atoms are originally things created by this Mind of ours.

第一釋名者，: 我今雖復昏迷倒惑， 苟能一念回心， 決定得生自己心中本具極樂， 更無疑慮，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Although we are deluded and confused, if for a single moment we return to this Mind, we are sure to be born in the Land of Ultimate Bliss originally inherent in our own mind, and be troubled no more by worry and doubt.

第一釋名者，: 是名信自。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: This is called "believing in ourselves".

第一釋名者，: 信他者， 信彼釋迦如來決無誑語， 彌陀世尊決無虛願，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: Believing in others means having faith that the Tathagata Sakyamuni certainly did not lie, and that the World Honored One Amitabha certainly did not take his vows in vain.

第一釋名者，: 六方諸佛廣長舌決無二言， 隨順諸佛真實教誨，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It means being certain that all the Buddhas of all the directions never equivocated, and it means following the true teachings of all the enlightened ones.

第一釋名者，: 決志求生更無疑惑，
First, there is the title of the sutra t: It means establishing our will to seek birth in the Pure Land, and being prey no more to doubt and confusion.

第一釋名者，: 是名信他。
First, there is the title of the sutra t: This is called "believing in others".
